summary: Specifies what a host's Internet Protocol implementation must do to support multicasting, sending one datagram to a group of machines. It supersedes RFC 966, which explains the motivation, and was a proposed standard. It was in turn replaced by RFC 1054 and RFC 1112.

eli5.summary: Instead of calling each friend one by one, you shout once and everyone who joined the group hears you. This memo says what a computer must do to join such groups.

questions: what are host extensions for ip multicasting
how does ip multicast work for hosts
